single_points_of_failure: ServiceNow Asset Lifecycle Engine (HAM Pro & SAM Pro)

scalability.expected_load: 50,000+ infrastructure CIs (physical servers, virtual machines, cloud instances, network devices) and 100,000+ software installation records processed within an 8-hour discovery window.
scalability.scaling_strategy: Horizontal scaling of MID Server clusters: auto-distributed load balancing across clustered MID nodes, each configured with 4-8 vCPUs, 8-16 GB RAM, and up to 50 concurrent worker threads. Additional MID Server nodes can be provisioned in minutes via Terraform in AWS or VMware templates on-premise to absorb growing workload volumes.
performance_targets: ECC Queue processing queue depth maintained below 5,000 concurrent messages at all times.
Average probe execution turnaround time under 45 seconds per host target.
Complete discovery cycle execution completed within scheduled 8-hour maintenance windows without schedule overrun.
CMDB IRE identification and insertion processing rate exceeding 200 CIs per minute during peak ingestion.

flagged_risks.description: Large-scale discovery sweeps across dense datacenter subnets may trigger Intrusion Detection/Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS) or cause temporary network congestion.
Concurrent execution of heavy discovery schedules can generate ECC Queue backpressure and message backlog exceeding 5,000 items, degrading sensor processing latency.
Excessive discovery of short-lived container instances (EKS/ECS) can flood the SAM software installation tables (cmdb_sam_sw_install) with transient noise, inflating license reconciliation workloads.
Potential credential exposure if target administrative passwords are saved to disk or exposed in discovery logs.
Compromise of MID Server host instance could provide lateral network access to discovered subnets.

declared_latency_targets.metric: Discovery window completion time and ECC Queue processing latency
declared_latency_targets.target: Complete discovery cycle within 8 hours; maintain ECC Queue queue depth below 5,000 messages

deepest_dependency_chain: ServiceNow Asset Lifecycle Engine (HAM Pro & SAM Pro)
